newsitem.title: UK: Pearson recovers after recent losses.
newsitem.headline: Pearson recovers after recent losses.

text.p: Shares in media group Pearson Plc rebounded from recent lows on Friday after losses of over six percent in just one week.
By 1007 GMT the shares were up 19p, or 2.7 percent, to 721-1/2p.
"Media stocks had been dull," said one trader. "They took a bit of a tumble and we're seeing a bit of a rebound today."
Shares in Pearson ended 20p lower at 702-1/2p on Thursday after falling from 749-1/2p at the beginning of the week.
"The stock had a very big fall yesterday but the market has now got itself sorted out," another trader commented.
Over the last month the media sector has underperformed the FTSE-All Share index by nearly 10 percent whilst Pearson has underperformed the rest of its sector by more than 16 percent.
"The market is looking very squeezy again today," a third dealer said. "People just don't want to sell and it's about time Pearson started catching up."
